login.description: As in twitch.tv/<login>. `null` until a read names the channel.

minutes.description: Minutes Twitch has confirmed for the drop.

requiredMinutes.description: Minutes the drop needs. `null`: not in the catalog.

Watching.description: The miner watches a channel for a drop.

reason.description: "starting": no catalog yet. "needs-login": parked on a rejected token. "catalog-unavailable": discovery is broken. "nothing-to-mine": no campaign the config asks for has a drop left to earn. "no-live-channel": there is one, but no eligible channel streams it now.

drop.description: `<game>: <drop>`, or `null` when the catalog doesn't hold the drop.

status.description: "sent": waiting for Twitch to answer. "unknown": the answer was lost; the next inventory read decides. Claims are never retried blindly.

drop.description: `<game>: <drop>`, or `null` when the catalog doesn't hold the drop.

at.description: When the claim settled. ISO 8601, UTC.

version.description: The format version. A reader refuses a version it doesn't know.

pid.description: The process id, in the miner's own pid namespace.

mode.description: "live" mines for real. "shadow" (`miner run --shadow`) reads and plans for real but only records what it would watch and claim.

startedAt.description: When this process started. ISO 8601, UTC.

heartbeatAt.description: When the miner last wrote this file. It writes on every change and at least every 30 s, so a heartbeat older than 90 s means it is gone or hung. ISO 8601, UTC.

anyOf.description: When the miner stopped cleanly. ISO 8601, UTC.

stoppedAt.description: When the miner stopped cleanly. `null`: not yet.

auth.description: "checking": the token is not validated yet. "valid": Twitch accepts it. "needs-login": Twitch rejected it; the miner is parked, polls nothing and waits for a new TOKEN and a restart.

status.description: "unknown": not read yet. "ok": the last read decoded. "unavailable": discovery is broken: Twitch answered `null` or the read failed after retries. Not the same as nothing to mine.

campaigns.description: Campaigns in the last catalog read.

inFlight.description: Claims sent and not yet settled.

claimedThisRun.description: Drops this process claimed (or settled as claimed) since it started.

anyOf.description: Last time Twitch accepted the token. ISO 8601, UTC.

validate.description: Last time Twitch accepted the token. `null`: not yet.

anyOf.description: Last successful catalog read. ISO 8601, UTC.

catalog.description: Last successful catalog read. `null`: not yet.

anyOf.description: Last successful inventory read. ISO 8601, UTC.

inventory.description: Last successful inventory read. `null`: not yet.

anyOf.description: Last successful directory or stream read. ISO 8601, UTC.

channels.description: Last successful directory or stream read. `null`: not yet.

anyOf.description: Last successful read of the drop the watch credits. ISO 8601, UTC.

currentDrop.description: Last successful read of the drop the watch credits. `null`: not yet.

anyOf.description: Last watch tick Twitch served. Always `null` in shadow mode. ISO 8601, UTC.

watchTick.description: Last watch tick Twitch served. Always `null` in shadow mode. `null`: not yet.

reads.description: When each kind of Twitch request last succeeded in this run.

listening.description: Sockets open and listening. Fewer than `connections` while reconnecting.

topics.description: Topics followed: the account's drops and channels.

dropped.description: Topics that didn't fit the connection limit.

pubsub.description: Twitch PubSub, the live/offline and drop-progress feed.

StatusFile.description: What the running miner writes to $DATA_DIR/status.json.

checkedAt.description: When `miner status` read the file. ISO 8601, UTC.

state.description: "healthy" and "starting" (exit 0): running, the token is valid or being checked, the catalog reads. "not-running" (exit 1): no status file, a clean stop, a heartbeat older than 90 s, or a file this version can't read. "needs-login" (exit 2): parked on a rejected token; set a new TOKEN and restart. "discovery-broken" (exit 3): the catalog is unavailable, so the miner can't tell whether there is anything to mine, or it has been starting for over 600 s (Twitch unreachable).

exitCode.description: The exit code of `miner status`: 0 healthy, 1 not running, 2 needs login, 3 discovery broken.

status.description: The status file as read, or `null` when there is none or it can't be read.

MinerStatus.title: miner status
MinerStatus.description: What `miner status --json` prints: a verdict on the miner's health from $DATA_DIR/status.json, and the file itself. The exit code repeats `health.exitCode`.
